med.name: Pulse
med.desc: Sends out a recon pulse that marks hostiles and allies through walls and covers

med.name: Recon Pack
med.desc: The pulse has an increased range and is capable of locating nearby loot containers

med.name: Scrambler
med.desc: The pulse protects the user and all allies from hostile pulse scans

med.name: Tactical Scanner
med.desc: Damage is increased when attacking any hostile targets identified by the pulse scan

med.name: First Aid
med.desc: Heals all allies within a small radius. The device can be used on location or launched to a distant target.

med.name: Defibrillator
med.desc: Applies instant healing followed by a heal over time. The device can revive downed allies with a portion of their normal health.

med.name: Overdose
med.desc: The device heals targets more efficiently, and may even extend the target's health beyond its normal rating.

med.name: Booster Shot
med.desc: Temporarily increases damage and resistance for the affected targets in addition to the normal healing effect

med.name: Support Station
med.desc: Drops a support station that heals allies and can be used to revive downed allies

med.name: Life Support
med.desc: Drops a revival station that automatically revives any allies who are downed within the affected area

med.name: Immunizer
med.desc: Drops a recovery station that removes Status Effects and makes allies immune while within the affected area

med.name: Ammo Cache
med.desc: While close to the device, allies regain their ammo as they reload, and skill cooldown recovery is faster.

tech.name: Sticky Bomb
tech.desc: Fires a bomb that sticks to most surfaces and explodes when detonated remotely

tech.name: BFB
tech.desc: Increases the damage and radius of the explosion and may cause targets to bleed

tech.name: Flashbang
tech.desc: The bomb explodes with a non-lethal effect that blinds all targets in range

tech.name: Disruptor
tech.desc: The explosive is replaced with an EMP alternative, causing Disrupt effects to all targets in an area.

tech.name: Turret
tech.desc: Deploys a stationary turret that attacks nearby hostiles until it is destroyed or its battery runs out

tech.name: Active Sensor
tech.desc: Increases the turret's damage and pulses attacked targets, making them visible to all allies.

tech.name: Dragonbreath
tech.desc: The turret has a reduced range but shoots a column of fire

tech.name: Zapper
tech.desc: The turret shoots electrical darts that shock the target

tech.name: Seeker Mine
tech.desc: Releases an automated mine that seeks out hostile targets before exploding on proximity

tech.name: Airburst
tech.desc: Upon impact, the mine is launched in the air and releases a cluster of small incendiary explosives.

tech.name: Gas Charge
tech.desc: Upon impact, the mine moves between multiple targets and releases a cloud of gas.

tech.name: Cluster
tech.desc: The mine separates into smaller mines that seek out multiple targets simultaneously

def.name: Ballistic Shield
def.desc: Equips a portable Ballistic Shield that absorbs damage. The user can only use their sidearm while the shield is active.

def.name: Reactive Targeting
def.desc: Equips a stronger and lighter shield that pulses hostiles who shoot at it

def.name: Assault Shield
def.desc: Equips a shield that grants the user's weapon increased damage, knockback, accuracy, and faster reload speed.

def.name: Kinetic Breaker
def.desc: Grants the user a small portion of incoming damage as healing

def.name: Smart Cover
def.desc: Reinforces a cover, increasing weapon performance and damage mitigation for allies behind it.

def.name: Trapper
def.desc: Allies in the area of effect are buffed, while enemies are debuffed for the same amounts.

def.name: Recharger
def.desc: Allies using a reinforced cover slowly recover their health and get their skill cooldowns decreased

def.name: Concealment
def.desc: Allies using a reinforced cover are hidden from hostile pulses and have reduced threat. Hostiles shot by allies from behind the cover are pulsed.

def.name: Mobile Cover
def.desc: Creates a temporary cover for one person, which provides standard cover protection until destroyed.

def.name: Extension
def.desc: The cover provides more protection and extends to protect two persons

def.name: Blast Shield
def.desc: The cover is fitted with remote explosives that damage and blind hostiles in front of it when the shield is disabled

def.name: Countermeasures
def.desc: While using the cover, the user deals increased damage and becomes immune to pulses.
